items.title: 【AI活用】頼み方を変えるだけで質が変わる——プロンプト「5要素」

items.title: Informer ：なぜ長い時系列予測を効率よくできるのか？
items.description: 最近、時系列予測モデルを勉強する中で、Informer という論文を読みました。 Informer は AAAI 2021 の Best Paper に選ばれた論文で、主に Long Sequence Time-series Forecasting（長い時系列の予測） を扱っています。 簡単に言うと、Informer は「未来の1点だけを予測するモデル」ではなく、過去の長い系列を見て、未来の長い区間をまとめて予測するためのモデルです。 例えば、過去96時点のデータを使って、未来24時点、48時点、96時点などを予測するようなイメージです。 この記事では、Informer の細かい数式をす...

items.tldr: CSVファイルと目的変数名を入力するだけで、回帰や分類の分析レポートを自動生成するPythonツールが紹介されています。このツールは、目的変数の分布や特徴量重要度、モデルの評価指標を自動で出力します。

items.title: California moves to exempt Linux from its upcoming age-verification law after backlash over forcing operating systems to collect users’ ages —  amendment proposed by the same lawmaker who wrote the original law
items.description: California lawmakers introduced a new amendment that could exempt most Linux distributions from the state’s upcoming Digital Age Assurance Act after privacy backlash and concerns that the law would force open-source operating systems to become age-verification platforms.
items.tldr: カリフォルニア州の議員が、プライバシーへの反発を受けて、デジタル年齢確認法からほとんどのLinuxディストリビューションを免除する新しい修正案を提案した。

items.title: 007 First Light Skips Pre-Load on Steam and Xbox; PlayStation 5 Will Be The Only Platform Due To Mandatory Requirement
items.description: 007 First Light launches this week on PC and consoles, but if you were hoping to pre-load the game ahead of release so as to experience James Bond's new story as soon as it becomes available, and you are not getting the game on PlayStation 5, you will be disappointed to know you won't be able to do
items.tldr: 「007 First Light」は今週PCとコンソールで発売されるが、PlayStation 5以外のプラットフォームでは事前ダウンロードができないため、プレイヤーはリリース直後にゲームを体験することができない。

items.title: Fan Petition for Destiny 3 Doubles Marathon’s Peak Concurrent Player Count on Steam as Bungie’s Future Hangs in the Balance
items.description: Last week, Bungie dropped a bomb on the video game industry with the announcement that its nearly-decade spanning shooter, Destiny 2, is no longer in active development and would not receive any more major updates past June 9, 2026. To call it the end of an era is an understatement, but fans are alr
items.tldr: TL;DR: BungieがDestiny 2の開発を終了し、2026年6月9日以降の大規模アップデートは行わないと発表したことで、ファンがDestiny 3のリリースを求める署名活動を開始し、Steamでのピーク同時接続プレイヤー数が急増した。

items.title: TSMC Scrambles To Calm Furious Employees With Promises Of Bigger Bonuses After CEO’s 30% Bonus Cut Comments Triggered Samsung-Style Revolt Fears
items.description: TSMC has moved rapidly to quell a wave of discontent among its employees following the widespread dissemination of rumors related to impending bonus cuts, with such fears only bolstered by the recent comments from TSMC's CEO himself. Now, amid fears of a Samsung-like upheaval that might disrupt its
items.tldr: TSMCは、CEOの30%ボーナスカットに関する発言が引き金となり、社員の不満が高まる中、ボーナス増額の約束をして従業員の不安を鎮めようと急いでいる。

items.title: Star Citizen reaches $1 billion in lifetime funding, 14 years after the project was first announced — game still in early access with no release window, including 'Squadron 42' campaign
items.description: Star Citizen, originally announced back in 2012, has just amassed $1 billion in crowdfunding despite the game still not having any release date. The game is currently expected sometime in 2027-2028, which means it might have to prepare a PS6/Xbox Helix version as well. A single game spanning across
items.tldr: Star Citizenは2012年に発表されて以来、リリース日未定のまま1億ドルの資金を集め、現在は2027-2028年のリリースが期待されています。

items.title: Intel Reportedly Prepares Nova Lake CPUs With 8 E-Cores & 12 Xe3P Cores For Edge Segment
items.description: Intel seems to be preparing a variant of its Nova Lake CPUs for Edge Applications that will feature just E-Cores and a strong iGPU. Intel Nova Lake CPUs For Edge To Pack Just E-Cores & Strong iGPU With 12 Xe3P Cores Last month, we reported that Intel was working on a variant of its Nova Lake CPU
items.tldr: Intelは、エッジアプリケーション向けにE-Coreと強力なiGPU（12 Xe3Pコア）を搭載したNova Lake CPUのバリアントを準備している模様です。

items.title: Huawei claims sanctions-busting breakthrough with 1.4nm-class chips by 2031, claims 55% higher transistor density — firm claims new LogicFolding chip architecture can bypass EUV restrictions, introduces 'Tau Scaling Law' to replace Moore's Law
items.description: Huawei Technologies unveiled a new “LogicFolding” chip design framework built on its proprietary Tau scaling law, claiming it can dramatically boost transistor density and power efficiency without EUV lithography — potentially helping China narrow the gap with TSMC and Nvidia despite U.S. sanctions.
items.tldr: Huaweiは、独自のTauスケーリング法に基づく新しい「LogicFolding」チップ設計フレームワークを発表し、EUVリソグラフィーを使用せずにトランジスタ密度と電力効率を大幅に向上させることができると主張しています。これにより、米国の制裁にもかかわらず、中国がTSMCやNvidiaとのギャップを縮める可能性があるとしています。

items.title: Ken Levine’s Judas Could Slip Nearly Three More Years, Putting BioShock Successor Eleven Years Deep in Development
items.description: Take-Two's latest quarterly report also featured an update on the publisher's lineup, including Judas, the next game by BioShock and System Shock 2 creator Ken Levine. According to Take-Two, Ghost Story Games is now targeting a launch between April 27 and March 2029, which incidentally is the same t
items.tldr: Ken Levineの新作ゲーム「Judas」は、2029年3月までの発売を目指しており、BioShockの後継作としての開発が11年に達する可能性がある。

items.title: AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT & RX 9060 XT Crash Below MSRP In Japan, Defying the Global RAMpocalypse
items.description: The AMD RDNA 4 GPU prices have been declining steadily in some regions, but it's hard to imagine such low prices in the RAMpocalypse era. AMD Radeon RX 9000 Series Drop to Record Low Prices in 2026; Both RX 9070 XT and RX 9060 XT are Now Below MSRP While the market continues to suffer from inflated
items.tldr: AMDのRadeon RX 9070 XTとRX 9060 XTが、日本でMSRPを下回る価格に急落し、グローバルなRAMpocalypseの影響を受けていないことが報告されています。

items.title: Micron Warns Memory Crunch Will Outlast 2026 as AI Demand Outpaces What HBM, DRAM and NAND Can Supply
items.description: US memory giant Micron believes that the shortage in the memory market when it comes to HBM, NAND and DRAM products will last well beyond calendar year 2026. Micron's thoughts were shared by JPMorgan in an investment note where the bank shared insights that the firm's management shared at the 54th J
items.tldr: TL;DR: マイクロンは、AI需要がHBM、DRAM、NANDの供給を上回るため、メモリ市場の不足が2026年を超えて続くと警告しています。

items.title: Intel Foundry’s Rio Rancho Facility To Become Its Crown Jewel In Production of Next-Gen Glass Substrates
items.description: Intel Foundry is leading the race towards Glass Substrates with its Rio Rancho facility, aiming to become the world's first to initiate mass production. Glass Substrates Are The Future of Semiconductors & Intel Foundry is Well on Its Way To Become The First To Initiate Mass Production Glass Core
items.tldr: Intel Foundryのリオランチョ施設が次世代ガラス基板の大量生産を開始する世界初の施設となることを目指しており、半導体の未来を切り開く重要な役割を果たす。

items.title: Samsung Leapfrogs Toward 1000-Layer NAND With First 900-Layer V-NAND Prototype, Stacking Two 450-Layer Cells Into One
items.description: Samsung is getting closer to its 1000-Layer V-NAND tech as it achieves the first 900-Layer prototype, bracing for swift competition with rivals. Samsung 900-Layer V-NAND Prototype Combines Two 450-Layer Cells Into One, As It Is Inches Away From 1000-Layer NAND Samsung is a pioneer in storage semicon
items.tldr: Samsungは、競争が激化する中で1000層V-NAND技術に向けて900層のプロトタイプを初めて達成し、2つの450層セルを1つに積み重ねる技術を実現しました。

items.title: PlayStation State of Play, June 2, 2026: Where to Watch, What to Expect Beyond Marvel’s Wolverine in 60-Minute-Long Showcase
items.description: Following a relatively quiet start to the year in terms of announcements, Sony has announced a massive PlayStation State of Play for Tuesday, June 2, 2026. Unlike previous presentations, this State of Play will be a lengthy one, kicking off the summer gaming season with many exciting reveals and upd
items.tldr: 2026年6月2日に開催されるPlayStation State of Playでは、MarvelのWolverineを超えた多くの新情報が発表される予定で、60分間の長時間のショーケースとなる。

items.title: Super Flower Leadex 2800W ATX 3.1 power supply review: Top-notch build quality, exceptional efficiency
items.description: The Super Flower Leadex 2800W is a technical statement rather than a conventional product. It delivers extraordinary efficiency, exemplary power quality, and an internal design that leaves nothing on the table. The asking price is extreme, but so is everything else about this unit.
items.tldr: TL;DR: Super Flower Leadex 2800Wは、卓越した効率と優れた電力品質を提供する高品質なATX 3.1電源であり、価格は高いもののその性能は群を抜いている。

items.title: Researchers identify people through ordinary Wi-Fi routers with 99.5% accuracy — technique works with standard Wi-Fi routers
items.description: The system requires no specialized hardware, no access to the target Wi-Fi network, and works even if the person being tracked isn't carrying a wireless device.
items.tldr: 研究者たちは、標準的なWi-Fiルーターを用いて99.5%の精度で人を特定する手法を開発し、特別なハードウェアやターゲットのWi-Fiネットワークへのアクセスなしで機能することを示しました。

items.title: APC PowerForge with Dell and NVIDIA at DTW 2026
items.description: At Dell Tech World 2026, we saw the APC PowerForge rack that went from a text prompt to 3D printed models on the show floor The post APC PowerForge with Dell and NVIDIA at DTW 2026 appeared first on ServeTheHome.
items.tldr: Dell Tech World 2026で、APC PowerForgeラックがテキストプロンプトから3Dプリントモデルに進化した様子が展示されました。

items.title: Save $170 on this lightning-fast, premium 3D printer combo featuring CoreXZ kinematics — Creality's Ender-3 V3 is on sale for just $419 right now with a multicolor upgrade kit
items.description: Creality's excellent Ender 3 V3 is on sale with a Co-Print multicolor upgrade kit that unlocks the final hurdle of the platform, allowing you to use the Ender 3 V3 as a multi-color powerhouse. This is a fantastic, extremely fast and well-built 3D printer with all the features you could ask for, rega
items.tldr: CrealityのEnder-3 V3が現在419ドルで販売中で、Co-Printマルチカラーアップグレードキットが付属しており、マルチカラー印刷が可能になります。これは非常に高速で高品質な3Dプリンターです。

items.title: Drone breaks world speed record with 453 mph in test run — exotic sawtooth carbon fiber propeller blades one of the key advances in the Blackbird design
items.description: A YouTuber duo unofficially broke the world record using a custom-made carbon fiber propeller blade that featured exotic sawtooth leading edges. The first test ended in a disaster, though, after the drone lost contact and crashed at 393 mph.
items.tldr: YouTuberのデュオが、エキゾチックな鋸歯状のカーボンファイバー製プロペラブレードを使用して、453 mphの速度でドローンの世界記録を更新したが、最初のテストでは393 mphで接触を失いクラッシュした。

items.title: After $2.5 billion Supermicro smuggling bust, Nvidia CEO urges company to fix export control compliance — Taiwan also begins to crack down on AI GPU chip smuggling to China
items.description: Huang told reporters at Songshan Airport that Nvidia insists its partners follow U.S. trade rules.
items.tldr: NvidiaのCEOは、Supermicroの25億ドルの密輸事件を受けて、同社の輸出管理遵守を強化するよう促し、台湾も中国へのAI GPUチップの密輸取り締まりを強化している。

items.title: First ever Cray T3D Supercomputer goes up for auction with $81,000 reserve — Europe’s fastest supercomputer in June 1996 goes on the block
items.description: The first Cray T3D supercomputer ever produced, serial number 6001, was recently put up for auction, with opening bids from £60,000 (~$81,000) invited.
items.tldr: 初代Cray T3Dスパコン（シリアル番号6001）がオークションに出品され、入札開始価格は約81,000ドル（£60,000）となっています。

items.title: Netherlands Seizes 800 Servers, Arrests 2 for Aiding Cyberattacks
items.description: Authorities in the Netherlands have arrested the co-owners of two related Internet hosting companies for operating IT infrastructure used by Russia to carry out cyberattacks, influence operations and disinformation campaigns inside the European Union. The two men were the focus of a 2025 KrebsOnSecu
items.tldr: オランダ当局は、ロシアによるサイバー攻撃や情報操作に使用されるITインフラを運営していた関連するインターネットホスティング会社の共同所有者2名を逮捕し、800台のサーバーを押収しました。

items.title: FBI warns of Kali365 phishing service targeting Microsoft 365 accounts
items.description: The FBI is warning about the Kali365 phishing-as-a-service platform (PhaaS) that is used to hijack Microsoft 365 accounts by abusing OAuth device code authentication to steal session tokens and bypass multi-factor authentication (MFA). [...]
items.tldr: FBIは、OAuthデバイスコード認証を悪用してMicrosoft 365アカウントを乗っ取るKali365フィッシングサービス（PhaaS）について警告しています。

items.title: Ghost CMS CVE-2026-26980 Exploited to Hijack 700+ Sites for ClickFix Attacks
items.description: Threat actors are exploiting a recently disclosed critical security flaw in Ghost CMS to inject malicious JavaScript code with an aim to fuel ClickFix attacks. According to QiAnXin XLab, the activity involves the exploitation of CVE-2026-26980 (CVSS score: 9.4), an SQL injection vulnerability in Gho
items.tldr: Ghost CMSのCVE-2026-26980という重大なセキュリティ脆弱性が悪用され、700以上のサイトがClickFix攻撃のために悪意のあるJavaScriptコードを注入されている。

items.title: The Alert Firehose Finally Meets Its Match
items.description: Ask a cybersecurity pro about Network Detection and Response (NDR) and you might still hear "Noisy," "Too much data." But ask the teams running NDR that includes agentic AI capabilities and you'll hear they're actually using it to catch threats earlier, triage faster, and chase fewer false positives
items.tldr: NDRにエージェントAI機能を組み込むことで、サイバーセキュリティチームは脅威を早期に検出し、迅速にトリアージを行い、誤検知を減らすことができるようになった。

items.title: Lazarus Deploys RemotePE Memory-Only RAT Against Financial and Crypto Firms
items.description: Cybersecurity researchers have shed light on a cross-platform malware called RemotePE that has been put to use by the North Korea-linked Lazarus Group in attacks targeting financial and cryptocurrency organizations. RemotePE, per NCC Group subsidiary Fox-IT, is part of a multi-stage attack chain tha
items.tldr: Lazarusグループが金融および暗号通貨企業を標的にした攻撃で、RemotePEというクロスプラットフォームのメモリ専用RATを使用していることが明らかになった。

items.title: TrapDoor Supply Chain Attack Spreads Credential-Stealing Malware via npm, PyPI, and CratesIO
items.description: A new coordinated cross-ecosystem software supply chain attack campaign has targeted npm, PyPI, and Crates.io to distribute credential-stealing malware. The campaign, codenamed TrapDoor, spans more than 34 malicious packages across over 384 versions. The earliest activity was recorded on May 22, 202
items.tldr: TrapDoorというコードネームの新たなソフトウェアサプライチェーン攻撃が、npm、PyPI、Crates.ioを通じて認証情報を盗むマルウェアを配布しており、34以上の悪意のあるパッケージと384以上のバージョンに及んでいます。

items.title: Ghost CMS SQL injection flaw exploited in large-scale ClickFix campaign
items.description: A large-scale campaign is exploiting a critical SQL injection vulnerability (CVE-2026-26980) in Ghost CMS to inject malicious JavaScript code that triggers ClickFix attack flows. [...]
items.tldr: Ghost CMSの重大なSQLインジェクション脆弱性（CVE-2026-26980）が悪用され、悪意のあるJavaScriptコードを注入する大規模なClickFix攻撃キャンペーンが展開されています。

items.title: Laravel Lang packages hijacked to deploy credential-stealing malware
items.description: A supply chain attack targeting the Laravel Lang localization packages has exposed developers to a sophisticated credential-stealing malware campaign after attackers abused GitHub version tags to distribute malicious code through Composer packages. [...]
items.tldr: Laravel Langのローカライズパッケージが標的となり、攻撃者がGitHubのバージョンタグを悪用してComposerパッケージを通じて認証情報を盗むマルウェアを配布する供給連鎖攻撃が発生した。

items.title: npm Adds 2FA-Gated Publishing and Package Install Controls Against Supply Chain Attacks
items.description: GitHub has rolled out new controls for npm to improve the security of the software supply chain, giving maintainers the ability to explicitly approve a release prior to the packages becoming publicly available for installation. Called staged publishing, the feature is now generally available on npm.
items.tldr: npmは、ソフトウェアサプライチェーンのセキュリティを向上させるために、維持管理者がパッケージの公開前にリリースを明示的に承認できる「ステージドパブリッシング」機能を一般提供開始しました。

items.title: Packagist Supply Chain Attack Infects 8 Packages Using GitHub-Hosted Linux Malware
items.description: A new "coordinated" supply chain attack campaign has impacted eight packages on Packagist including malicious code designed to run a Linux binary retrieved from a GitHub Releases URL. "Although the affected packages were all Composer packages, the malicious code was not added to composer.json," Sock
items.tldr: Packagistでの新たな供給チェーン攻撃により、GitHubホストのLinuxマルウェアを使用した8つのパッケージが感染し、Composerパッケージに悪意のあるコードが追加されましたが、composer.jsonには含まれていませんでした。

items.title: Italy disrupts CINEMAGOAL piracy app that stole streaming auth codes
items.description: Italian authorities have dismantled a piracy ecosystem centered around the CINEMAGOAL app that provided access to various streaming platforms, including Netflix, Disney+, and Spotify. [...]
items.tldr: イタリア当局は、NetflixやDisney+、Spotifyなどのストリーミングプラットフォームへのアクセスを提供していたCINEMAGOALアプリを中心とした海賊行為のエコシステムを解体しました。

items.title: Claude Mythos AI Finds 10,000 High-Severity Flaws in Widely Used Software
items.description: Anthropic on Friday disclosed that Project Glasswing has helped uncover more than 10,000 high- or critical-severity vulnerabilities across some of the most "systemically" important software across the world since the cybersecurity initiative went live last month. Project Glasswing is a defensive eff
items.tldr: TL;DR: Anthropicのプロジェクト「Glasswing」が、先月の開始以来、世界中の重要なソフトウェアで10,000以上の高・重大な脆弱性を発見したことを発表しました。

items.title: Laravel-Lang PHP Packages Compromised to Deliver Cross-Platform Credential Stealer
items.description: Cybersecurity researchers have flagged a fresh software supply chain attack campaign that has targeted multiple PHP packages belonging to Laravel-Lang to deliver a comprehensive credential-stealing framework. The affected packages include - laravel-lang/lang laravel-lang/http-statuses laravel-lang/a
items.tldr: Laravel-Langの複数のPHPパッケージがサプライチェーン攻撃により、包括的な資格情報窃取フレームワークを配信するために侵害されたことが報告されています。

items.title: LiteSpeed cPanel Plugin CVE-2026-48172 Exploited to Run Scripts as Root
items.description: A maximum-severity security vulnerability impacting LiteSpeed User-End cPanel Plugin has come under active exploitation in the wild. The flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-48172 (CVSS score: 10.0), relates to an instance of incorrect privilege assignment that an attacker could abuse to run arbitrary scripts
items.tldr: LiteSpeed User-End cPanel Pluginの重大なセキュリティ脆弱性（CVE-2026-48172）が悪用され、攻撃者が任意のスクリプトをルート権限で実行できる状況が発生しています。

items.title: Drupal Core SQL Injection Bug Actively Exploited, Added to CISA KEV
items.description: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has added a recently patched critical security flaw impacting Drupal Core to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, based on evidence of active exploitation. The vulnerability in question is CVE-2026-9082 (CVSS score: 6.5),
items.tldr: Drupal CoreのSQLインジェクション脆弱性（CVE-2026-9082）が、アクティブな悪用の証拠に基づき、米国のCISAによって既知の悪用脆弱性リストに追加されました。

items.title: Friday Squid Blogging: Regulating Squid Fishing in the South Pacific
items.description: The South Pacific Regional Fisheries Management Organization (SPRFMO) needs to regulate squid fishing in the South Pacific. As usual, you can also use this squid post to talk about the security stories in the news that I haven’t covered. Blog moderation policy.
items.tldr: 南太平洋地域漁業管理機関（SPRFMO）は、南太平洋におけるイカ漁の規制が必要である。

items.title: Netherlands seizes 800 servers of hosting firm enabling cyberattacks
items.description: Financial crime investigators in the Netherlands (FIOD) arrested two men and seized 800 servers linked to a web hosting company that enabled cyberattacks, interference operations, and disinformation campaigns. [...]
items.tldr: オランダの金融犯罪捜査官（FIOD）は、サイバー攻撃や情報操作を可能にしたウェブホスティング会社に関連する800台のサーバーを押収し、2人を逮捕した。

items.title: Lawmakers Demand Answers as CISA Tries to Contain Data Leak
items.description: Lawmakers in both houses of Congress are demanding answers from the U.S. Cybersecurity & Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) after KrebsOnSecurity reported this week that a CISA contractor intentionally published AWS GovCloud keys and a vast trove of other agency secrets on a public GitHub ac
items.tldr: 議会の議員たちは、CISAの契約者がAWS GovCloudキーやその他の機密情報を公のGitHubアカウントに意図的に公開したことについて、CISAに説明を求めています。

items.title: Akamai Joins Growing Chorus of Vendors Betting Big on Secure Enterprise Browsers
items.description: When Akamai announced its LayerX acquisition, the company joined a growing list of vendors adding secure enterprise browsers to their product portfolios.
items.tldr: AkamaiはLayerXを買収し、セキュアエンタープライズブラウザを製品ポートフォリオに追加するベンダーの増加に加わった。

items.title: Former US execs plead guilty to aiding tech support scammers
items.description: Two former executives of a call-tracking and analytics company pleaded guilty to concealing a years-long tech support fraud scheme that victimized individuals worldwide. [...]
items.tldr: 元米国の幹部2名が、世界中の個人を標的にした長年のテクニカルサポート詐欺スキームを隠蔽した罪を認めた。
